rca_of_issue: Original bug: inner ScrollView (maxHeight:240) inside Screen's outer ScrollView caused nested-scroll gesture conflict on mobile web/touch — parent captured touch, inner list unusable. Fix (already applied by main agent): replaced inner ScrollView with plain View so the outer ScrollView handles all scrolling as one continuous scroll. Verified: only one scrollable element exists in the modal DOM (sh=1793, ch=774) and add-eq-list computed style is overflowY:visible, maxHeight:none. Save Rental reachable, no dead zones.
